about: Declarative Player decks for prototype slideshows and audio-first sequences. Prototype-only; clinical, localization, audio, and asset approval remain pending.

steps.imageDesc: Caregiver washing hands beside a clean cup and clean water.
Caregiver choosing the actual household container before measuring water for ORS.
Clean water measured to a clearly labeled 1 L fill line on a container; if no line is visible, choose another measured container and do not guess.
One full unbranded ORS sachet being emptied into exactly 1 liter of already measured clean water in a marked mixing jug.
Caregiver holding a marked 1 liter mixing jug steady and stirring prepared ORS thoroughly with a clean long spoon.
Prepared ORS kept covered and used the same day, with old ORS discarded.
